title: Saving a round that someone else discarded just says 'Round not found' and keeps offering Save
steps: Maya: open the in-play round, type all four trick counts
Dan (other browser): session page -> Discard round -> confirm
expected: A plain message that another player discarded this round, the typed draft dropped, and a way back to the session
actual: '(alert) Round not found' under the pad, Save round still enabled, the page otherwise unchanged; the draft key whistmate:round-draft:<id> stays in localStorage. Only a reload shows the 'Round not found / Back to sessions' page.
suggested_fix: On a 404 from save/lock, replace the screen with the 'Round not found' state ('Another player discarded this round') and clear the round's draft.

title: A scored round's own page has no tab bar and does not name its session or date
steps: Open a scored round from a player's round history or a session card
expected: Ruling 1: round pages light the Sessions tab; the page says which session (name, date) the round belongs to
actual: Only '← Session', '# Round 5', the badge and four rows; no bottom tab bar (no nav links in the DOM) and no session name or date, so a round opened from a player's history has no context.
evidence: eval: no a[href=/history] on the page
suggested_fix: Keep the tab bar on the read-only round page (hide it only on entry/edit screens) and add 'Session name · date' under the title.

title: Closed session with a round limit shows '2 played' and '3 rounds played' on the same screen
where: /session/:id (closed session with round limit and one everyone-falls round)
steps: Start a session with Round limit 3
Play rounds incl. one where everyone falls
expected: One count, or the second labelled ('3 rounds, 1 cancelled')
actual: Header 'Round limit 3 · 2 played' and, two lines below, 'FINAL RESULT Maya won · +52 / 3 rounds played · the session is closed'.
evidence: 'Round limit 3 · 2 played' / '3 rounds played · the session is closed'
suggested_fix: Say '3 rounds played (1 everyone-falls, not counted toward the limit)' or 'Round limit 3 · 2 counted'.

title: Note header cuts the session date at 320 px
steps: At 320x568 open /profile as Maya and scroll to TABLE TALK
actual: 'Season opener · Jul 2, 20…' — the year is cut with an ellipsis.
suggested_fix: Let the note's meta line wrap instead of truncating.

title: Remaining tap targets under 44 px outside the round screens
expected: Ruling 15/39: every tappable thing ≥44x44; no 36-px buttons
actual: Award holder links 53x36 ('Dan', 'Maya'); inline session link in 'A session is still open (ליל שישי ארוך)' 72x15; 'Log in' link on /register 40x44; every /app-admin action button 36 px tall ('Archive', 'Delete', 'Purge data', 'Make admin', 'Clean orphans').
evidence: sweep output: '53x36 Dan', '72x15 ליל שישי ארוך', '40x44 Log in'
suggested_fix: Give these links a 44-px hit area and switch app-admin buttons to the 44-px size.

title: Opening a session link of a group you are not in silently lands on Your groups
where: /session/:id as a non-member (e.g. right after leaving the group)
expected: A short 'You're not in this group' state (or 'this group's session isn't available to you')
actual: Redirect to /home with no message; only a 403 'You are not a member of this group' in the network log.
evidence: ! http 403 POST .../getGroupData — {"error":"You are not a member of this group"}
suggested_fix: Show the shared error state with 'This session belongs to a group you're not in' and a link to Your groups.

title: AVG / ROUND shows 0 for someone with no rounds
steps: Sign up, join a group, open Me
expected: '—' like the other rates with nothing to count (ruling 12)
actual: 'AVG / ROUND 0' and 'AVERAGE BID 0' beside 'WIN RATE —' and 'CONTRACT ACCURACY —'.
evidence: '[4] button "AVG / ROUND 0"', '[11] button "AVERAGE BID 0"' for vera.new
suggested_fix: Show '—' for averages over zero rounds.

title: Archive is offered and confirmed even though the page already says it cannot work
where: Admin › Danger zone with a session open
steps: With a session open, Admin › Archive -> confirm
expected: Archive disabled while 'A session is still open — close it before archiving' is shown
actual: The confirmation 'Archive Thursday Whist?' opens and only after confirming does '(alert) Close the open session first' appear (409).
evidence: ! http 409 POST .../setGroupStatus — {"error":"Close the open session first"}
suggested_fix: Disable Archive while a session is open (the explanatory line is already there).
